'''Kagami-no-Miya Shrine''' (鏡宮神社) refers to Shinto shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Kagami-no-Miya Shrine (Takasaki)|ja|鏡宮神社 (高崎市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kagami-no-Miya Shrine (Takasaki)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Koyagi-cho, Takasaki City, Gunma Prefecture.
